zh: 修复点击工具卡片的三个点时误打开工具的问题。工具分类计数会随收藏和搜索筛选更新。
管理员可以原位更新自定义工具，保留访问权限和中英文名称。更新失败时恢复原工具文件和注册信息。
优化网页和桌面端的额度趋势图，并改善深色设置界面和外部会话输入栏的显示。
en: Fixed the three-dot button on tool cards so it opens the action menu. Category counts now reflect favorite and search filters.
Admins can update custom tools in place while preserving access permissions and both names. Failed updates restore the previous files and registry entry.
Improved quota charts on web and desktop, dark settings panels, and composer layout for external sessions.
